title: Behind the Memo: I Beg To Differ
summary:
So when you do something which is
different and bear the risk of being wrong, that wrongness can be penalized. Dave Swenson ran the endowment at Yale from 1985 until 2021, and he had among the one, two, three
best numbers for a very long period, and his margin of superiority was huge. In many ways, he was different, and in many ways, he took the risk of
of being wrong.
